title: What to expect ahead of the Fed's September interest rate decision

title: How Far Can Adobe Stock Fall While It Waits On Freemium?
summary: Adobe (ADBE) trades near $252, about 31% below its 52-week high, and the past week alone took 11.7% off it. Over the trailing twelve months the stock has lost 28% while the S&P 500 gained about 19%. That underperformance wasn't driven by broad market weakness. Adobe decided to stop putting an immediate paywall in front of its newest users, and that is what makes this fall hard to size.
